title: Keep existing documentation debt separate from a new change
preconditions: Use shopSaga; commit an undocumented queue behavior change on main, then branch and commit only an added header.

steps.action: Reconcile the header-only branch against main.
steps.expected_result: One stale reference is pre-existing, with zero regressions.

expected_result: One stale reference is pre-existing debt and no regression is attributed to the header change.
